name: Visitor Entry / Visa

requirements.blocker_text: A valid passport is required of all persons entering The Bahamas.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain or renew a valid passport.

requirements.blocker_text: A return or onward ticket and a valid travel document permitting entry to another country are required.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a return or onward ticket.

requirements.blocker_text: Visitors are not allowed to engage in any form of gainful occupation (work).

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds (may be requested)

outcome.duration_length: up to 8 months for most visa-exempt visitors, subject to immigration officer discretion

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Entry Requirements: visa-exempt nationalities (US, Canada, UK, most Commonwealth and South American countries), passport and onward-ticket requirement, up to 8 months stay for US citizens at officer discretion, no gainful occupation permitted

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. Stay length varies significantly by nationality (US citizens up to 8 months; Canadians up to 30 days; most South Americans up to 3 months) and is ultimately at the immigration officer's discretion -- modelled with the longest commonly-cited figure (8 months) as the outcome duration, with the caveat noted. Visa-required nationalities must consult the 'Before Your Arrival' page for country-specific rules, which was not separately fetched for this build.
